sentence: This project gets an instrument that measures trace metals and other elements in sediments, water and biological tissues to study pollution.
This project restarts a radio telescope to map molecular gas, study magnetic fields in the low corona, and monitor pulsars.
This project studies how the combined effects of gene copies change survival and seed production in plants grown in simulated native environments.
This project uses statistical physics to study how catalysts help quantum computers solve hard optimization problems.
This project builds a deep learning framework for data with geometric shapes, such as graphs, point clouds and meshes.
This project builds a knowledge base of how people behave in different relationships and uses it to make computer language systems more aware of social behavior.
This project studies how co-creating robots with artificial intelligence affects the learning of computing, using interviews and interaction data.
This project builds thin layered materials atom by atom to test for a state of matter called a topological superconductor.
This project tries to find out which genes and pathways make early embryonic cells become the cells that turn into eggs and sperm.
This project tries to find out how warm a gas of atoms can be and still keep its quantum wave-like behavior.
This project builds mathematical models and learning methods for systems where many interacting agents make decisions.
This project studies how one enzyme controls where another enzyme stops reading DNA, and how human cells respond to stress.
This project builds tools that use radar images and deep learning to find flooded areas quickly and accurately.
This project builds ways for unmanned aerial vehicles to train machine learning models together while keeping raw data local and resisting attacks.
This project studies how attackers recover deep neural network models from compiled programs and builds compiler defenses against it.
This project builds a system that translates freehand drawings into parametric Computer Aided Design programs using deep neural networks.
This project builds a robot that learns on its own and saves energy by computing in a way more like human brains.
